# Air: Berkson measurement error
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_2.air
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model
{
   for(j in 1 : J) {
      y[j] ~ dbin(p[j], n[j])
      logit(p[j]) <- theta[1] + theta[2] * X[j]
      X[j] ~ dnorm(mu[j], tau)
      mu[j] <- alpha + beta * Z[j]
   }
   theta[1] ~ dnorm(0.0, 0.001)
   theta[2] ~ dnorm(0.0, 0.001)
}
""", false)

build_model(data) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data)
